nom: VIDIVICI Clear Gentle Calming Deep Cleansing Oil

avis.texte: This Vidivici oil cleanser is thicker than most others I’ve tried. I really like that because it’s viscous enough so it doesn’t slip off my face as soon as I apply it. It quickly emulsifies my makeup, including eye makeup. I don’t wear waterproof makeup, but I do wear sunscreen, a lot of skin care, and it’s been hot and sweaty around here. I feel this oil cleanser does a really good job taking the day off my face. It is easy to emulsify and rinse off, but I still always finish face washing routine with a gel cleanser. However, I am taking one star off due to the very strong fragrance. I personally would have liked it to have no fragrance, but even a lighter fragrance would have been better. The fragrance starts a little floral, but overall it has a very generic masculine cologne smell. When washing my face at night, I am trying to take the day off my face. I want this to be a reset. Adding a strong fragrance is not ideal to the process of resetting. The box comes sealed, which I really appreciate for product safety.

I had such high expectations for this product even before I tried it, simply because the reviews were overwhelmingly positive—and I have to say, it truly lived up to the hype. The pump packaging makes it so convenient to use, and I love that the bottle is transparent, so I can easily keep track of how much is left. It feels practical yet sleek at the same time. The texture is luxuriously soft and glides effortlessly over the skin. What impressed me most is how well it emulsifies—makeup just melts away without needing to rub or massage harshly. I usually wear sunscreen and foundation on a daily basis, and this cleanser not only removes every trace of makeup but also works deep into the pores to clear out impurities. Another huge plus for me is that it doesn’t sting the eyes at all, which is rare with cleansers. After rinsing, my skin feels clean, fresh, and hydrated—never tight or dry. It leaves behind that perfectly balanced feeling, as if my skin can actually breathe. One minus is that smell is less than appealing. I don't really like the smell very much. I can't even explain it, it just has a weird smell to it. That's pretty much the only minus though for me. As someone with sensitive and dry skin, I’m always cautious about trying new cleansing products. But this one is truly a game-changer for me—it’s gentle, effective, and feels like the perfect match for my skin’s needs. I can confidently say this is one of the best cleansing products I’ve ever used, and I can definitely
This cleanser works very well. It melts away makeup with ease and left my skin clean yet moisturized. It has a clean herbal fragrance and has been gentle on my skin with no irratation.

avis.titre: Korean Cleansing oil with peptides and ceramidesKorean Cleansing oil with peptides and ceramides
avis.texte: I normally use another popular Korean skincare cleansing oil in the evenings as part of my double cleanse method so I wanted to give this new oil a try. The key difference between the two oils is that VIDIVICI cleansing oil contains Palmitoyl Tetrapeptide-10 which is a synthetic peptide used for its anti-aging and skin repairing properties as well as Ceramide NP for skin barrier support. I believe this oil is a great choice for those seeking extra barrier support and anti aging benefits, (may not be the best match for acne prone skin) I also want to mention that this is a large bottle that will last a long time, 300ml! I have used the oil a few times now and can say that it works well, my skin feels smooth and soft, happy with my purchase

avis.titre: Melts away makeup without drying my skin
avis.texte: This cleansing oil feels silky going on and rinses off clean without leaving any residue or tightness. I have sensitive, sometimes reactive skin, and this has been really gentle while still removing sunscreen, foundation, and even waterproof mascara. My skin feels calm and hydrated afterward, not stripped or irritated. The scent is very mild and pleasant. I've been using it at night as my first cleanse and it's helped keep my skin clear and soft. A little goes a long way, so one bottle should last a while. Definitely a staple in my routine now.

Love this cleansing oil. It does have fragrance but not overpowering and smells like trees and national parks rather than floral. It is a very refreshing scent and works for both morning and evening cleansing. The consistency is a little thinner compared to others I’ve used but worked great on cleaning off light makeup and sunscreen. I love that it doesn’t feel greasy and washes off easily.

avis.titre: strong fragrance but works well in a first step cleanse routinestrong fragrance but works well in a first step cleanse r
avis.texte: Nice oil cleanser that isn't runny. It's a bit thicker than what I'm used to but it works well to get my makeup off and gentle enough for my eye area. You do have to use this with another cleanser and usually have a 5-6 step process in my day and nighttime skin routine. I feel like it works well enough as a first step cleanse, rinse off is easy enough. It has a strong fragrance so that takes getting use to. It is gentle for my sensitive skin as I haven't noticed any breakouts or rashes with use.

avis.titre: Pre cleanser to remove make up and sunblock
avis.texte: Wanted to try cleansing oil to remove sunblock and foundation for a while now. First thing is that it has a pleasant grassy smell and not overly scented and perfumey. I took a couple of pumps, rubbed onto my face and then rubbed it in with my hands; over eyes, lips, even down my neck for a minute or so and washed off. I followed up with usual cleanser and my face felt so clean and soft. Just be careful not to get any in the eyes because it burns. I have to admit though my skin tends to be a bit on the oilier side so this may be my winter makeup remover. For those who like gua sha, this will be great for slip and at the same time prep your skin for washing.

This is a great facial cleansing oil. It has become my absolute favorite. There is no noticeable scent which is really awesome if you are averse to strong smells or pregnant. I had dealt with break outs for a few weeks until I tried this and as soon as I started using it, my breakouts began to clear up. My skin also feels softer and smoother since I've begun using it. I would highly recommend!

avis.titre: Turns milky when mixed with water. *VERY* definite fragrance that lingers :-((
avis.texte: This does a pretty good job cleaning off the daily grime. Out of the bottle it is a clear liquid, but as soon as it is mixed with water it turns milky. I'm giving it a three star rating because of the fragrance. It is not unpleasant, but it lingers, and unless you enjoy living inside a floral fragrance bubble, it quickly gets old.

I was hesitant about an "oil cleanser" but the texture is wonderful and the smell is amazing. It's super hydrating and left my skin feeling smooth, hydrated, and refreshed. I did my normal foam facial cleanser afterwards, and my skin is still soft and hydrated. So, to me this is really a wonderful spa like experience. I'm definitely impressed with it.

avis.titre: It works, but it takes some time to get off
avis.texte: This is my first cleansing oil and I can say that it does work to clean my skin without being overly aggressive. At the end of a wash, I do feel a very light exfoliating effect. That said, I found it really took quite some time to get the oil off, and I don't think it quite worked as well as other exfoliates that I have. It is possible that this is just a bit too gentle for my skin, and I'm looking for a bit more oomph from both a cleaner and an exfoliant.

I like to use cleansing oil in the winter to avoid drying out my skin. The Vidivici cleansing oil has a natural spa-like scent that reminds me of pine. This oil is soothing and does not irritate my skin. The bottle is attractive and generously sized. Highly recommended.

VIDIVICI Clear Gentle Calming Deep Cleansing Oil is a facial cleanser and makeup remover. As someone with sensitive skin, I appreciate this product for gently soothing sensitive skin while reinforcing the moisture barrier and providing hydration. With two pumps of this cleansing oil, I was able to remove all the makeup on my face which included tinted moisturizer, mineral powder, concealer, blush, eyeshadow, and eyebrow pencil. After rinsing off the cleansing oil, my face felt soft and nourished. There was no irritation or discomfort.

This cleansing oil has quickly become one of my favorite cleansing oils. It’s a lightweight, smooth formula that melts away makeup and sunscreen effortlessly—even waterproof mascara—without tugging at the skin. What I love most is how gentle it feels. With ceramides included, it not only removes impurities but also helps protect the skin barrier, leaving my skin soft and hydrated instead of tight or stripped. It rinses cleanly with water, turning into a light milky texture, which makes removal quick and easy. I did not experience any redness or irritation and Miskin feels calm, balanced, and refreshed after using. The large 10.14 fl.oz bottle is also a great value because just a few pumps are enough for a full cleanse.

First off this is just gorgeous packaging - it looks really high end. It states that it is dermatologically tested for sensitive skin so its audience is likely skin types that may be more dry since it is an oil based skin cleanser. I really like that it is a pump bottle and it’s a very good amount for the price. It has a light fragrance and seems to work well. I’ll have to see how it feels with continued use but first impression is that this is a nice and gentle daily facial cleanser.

avis.titre: I Love The Smell Of This Cleansing Oil
avis.texte: The VIDIVICI Deep Cleansing Oil is lightweight and gentle. It has a nice subtle, fresh scent and cleansed my face without stinging or causing any reaction. It also rinsed off easily, and left my skin looking clean. My skin is oily and acne-prone, so I’m looking forward to using this gentle calming cleansing oil.
